rappel_detail.anchor: a fixed piton near the north corner, if found; otherwise slings on a horn or chockstone
rappel_detail.station: Just below the summit, about 50 ft below the top near the north corner.
rappel_detail.notes: One rappel down the broken chimney and face toward the gully; parties downclimb it when it is dry. Carry webbing or cord: at least one party found no fixed anchor on this line.
hazards: Loose rock in the chimney and gully below.

set.rappel_count_note: One rappel near the top, or none if the party downclimbs. Reports disagree on whether a fixed piton is in place, so be ready to build an anchor. Its length is not published.
